content:
name: publish-with-git-tag-version

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  publish-with-git-tag-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:

      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      # trusted publishing over OIDC needs npm >= 11.5.1
      - run: npm install -g npm@latest

      - run: npm ci

      - run: npm run build

      # --allow-same-version so that a release can be re-cut from a master
      # that was already bumped by an earlier, failed run
      - run: npm version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version $(git describe --abbrev=0 --tags)

      # publish before pushing the version commit, so that a failed publish
      # doesn't leave master with a version that is not on the registry.
      # authenticated over OIDC, provenance is generated automatically
      - run: npm publish

      - run: |
          git config --local user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git commit -m "update version" -a || echo "version is already up to date"

      - uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v1.3.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
